en.title: Number of Calls to Equalize Feedback Counts
en.description:
Each call can only increase or decrease one product's feedback count by 1. Each target starts independently from the original array; output the minimum number of calls to turn every feedback count into that target. The source's first example output conflicts with the statement; this site corrects it to 9 using the per-item absolute differences.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n q, the second line n feedback counts, and the third line q targets. 1≤n,q≤100000, values 1..1000000.
en.output: Output q integers in query order.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three examples are 9; 4 3; 0 1.
hints: Sort and build prefix sums; binary search the split point for the target, then compute the total cost of raising the left part and lowering the right part separately.
